parts.name: liner_helmet_half
sources: The liner: EPS of 30 mm and 45 kg/m3, the least thickness and the middle density of a liner (Trzaskalska and Chwastek, 2021).

parts.name: shell_helmet_half
sources: The shell: ABS of 4 mm, the least of a thermoplastic shell (Trzaskalska and Chwastek, Archives of Metallurgy and Materials 66, 2021); a peak of 40 mm at the front, by eye.

parts.name: strap_helmet_half
sources: The strap: a webbing of 20 mm with a buckle under the chin, by eye.
